privacy.title: Umgaqo-nkqubo Wabucala
privacy.description: Indlela I Need Convert ephatha ngayo idatha neefayile zakho. Iifayile ziguqulwa kwibhrawuza yakho kwaye azinakuze zifakwe kwiiseva zethu.
privacy.body:
I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com) sisixhobo sasimahla sokuguqula imifanekiso, iividiyo, isandi, amaxwebhu, ii-PDF, ii-spreadsheet nedatha, esilawulwa ngu-Abid Hanan Wicaksono. Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uchaza ukuba yeyiphi idatha eqhutywayo xa usebenzisa le webhusayithi nendlela esiyiphatha ngayo. Ngabom siqokelela idatha encinci kangangoko kunokwenzeka: akufuneki ubhalise, ungene, okanye unike igama lakho ne-imeyile ukuze usebenzise le nkonzo.

Iifayile oziguqulayo

Lonke uguqulo lwenzeka ngqo kwibhrawuza yakho. Iifayile ozikhethayo zifundwa kwaye ziqhutywe sisixhobo sakho ngokwaso, ze iziphumo zigcinwe ngqo kwisixhobo sakho. Iifayile zakho nemixholo yazo azifakwa nanini na kwiiseva zethu, asizigcini, kwaye asinakuzibona. Xa uvala okanye ulayisha kwakhona iphepha, ezo fayile ziyaphela kwimemori yebhrawuza.

Idatha esiyiqhubayo

  • Idatha yobugcisa. Njengazo phantse zonke iiwebhusayithi, umboneleli wethu we-hosting (Cloudflare) urekhoda idatha yobugcisa yezicelo, efana nedilesi ye-IP, uhlobo lwebhrawuza nexesha lokufikelela, ngenjongo yokhuseleko nokusebenza. Ezi rekhodi zigcinwa okwethutyana kuphela ngokomgaqo-nkqubo weCloudflare.
  • Iinkcukacha-manani zamanqaku. Amanani okujongwa, okuthandwa nokwabelwana agcinwa njengezimbuku zenqaku ngalinye, ngaphandle kwayo nayiphi na idatha enokukuchonga.

Iikhuki nokugcina kwibhrawuza

  • inc-lang (localStorage): ikhumbula ulwimi olukhethileyo. Le datha ihlala kwisixhobo sakho.
  • Iikhuki zohlalutyo zamaqela esithathu ezivela kwi-Google Analytics nakwi-Microsoft Clarity, ezichazwe apha ngezantsi.
  • Ugcino lwasekhaya (localStorage kunye ne-sessionStorage): lukhumbula amanqaku owathandileyo kwaye luthintela ukuba utyelelo olunye lubalwe kabini. Le datha ihlala kwisixhobo sakho.

Uhlalutyo

Sisebenzisa izixhobo zohlalutyo ukuze siqonde indlela esetyenziswa ngayo iwebhusayithi nokuze siyiphucule:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): isebenzisa iikhuki ukulinganisa amaphepha owavulayo, ilizwe okulo ngokuqikelelwa, uhlobo lwesixhobo sakho, neziganeko ezifana nokucofa amaqhosha okukhuphela. Idatha isetyenzwa yi-Google ngokuhambisana noMgaqo-nkqubo wabucala we-Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: ilayishwa xa uqala ukusebenzisana nephepha. I-Clarity irekhoda unxibelelwano olufana nokucofa nokuskrola ukwenzela iimephu zobushushu (heatmaps) neerekhodi zeeseshoni, kwaye ifihla oko ukuchwetheza kwiindawo zokufaka. Idatha isetyenzwa yi-Microsoft ngokuhambisana neNkcazo yabucala ye-Microsoft.

Ungaphuma kuhlalutyo ngokuvimba iikhuki zamaqela esithathu kwiisetingi zebhrawuza yakho, ngokusebenzisa isivimbi sokulandelela, okanye ngokufaka i-Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Iwebhusayithi iyaqhubeka isebenziseka ngokupheleleyo.

Iinkonzo zamaqela esithathu

  • Cloudflare, Inc. ibonelela nge-hosting. Iiseva zayo zinokuba ngaphandle kwe-Indonesia.
  • jsDelivr ibonelela ngenjini yokuguqula iividiyo nesandi. Le njini ikhutshelwa kwibhrawuza yakho okokuqala xa uguqula ividiyo okanye isandi, ngoko idilesi yakho ye-IP iyabonakala kwi-jsDelivr. Iifayile zakho azithunyelwa.
  • Google Fonts isetyenziselwa ukubonisa ezinye iinkqubo zokubhala (umzekelo, isiArabhu, isiThai, okanye isiJapan). Xa iifonti zilayishwa, idilesi yakho ye-IP iyabonakala kuGoogle.
  • Amaqhosha okwabelana (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) aqhagamshelana nezo nkonzo kuphela xa uwacofa.

Ukhuseleko nokwabelana ngedatha

Lonke unxibelelwano nale webhusayithi lusebenzisa i-HTTPS. Asiyithengisi, asiyiqeshisi, kwaye asirhwebi ngedatha yobuqu. Idatha yabelwana kuphela nababoneleli beenkonzo abakhankanywe ngasentla kangangoko kuyimfuneko ukuqhuba iwebhusayithi, okanye xa kufunwa ngumthetho.

Abantwana

Le nkonzo ayenzelwanga abantwana abangaphantsi kweminyaka eli-13, kwaye asiqokeleli ngabom idatha yobuqu yabantwana.

Amalungelo akho

Ngokomthetho wase-Indonesia onguNombolo 27 wonyaka wama-2022 woKhuselo lweDatha yoBuqu, unelungelo lokucela ukufikelela, ukulungiswa, okanye ukucinywa kwedatha yakho yobuqu, kunye nokurhoxisa imvume yokuba iqhutywe. Ekubeni phantse singayigcini idatha ekuchazayo, uninzi lwezicelo lunokusonjululwa ngokucima idatha yesayithi kwiisetingi zebhrawuza yakho. Ngezinye izicelo, qhagamshelana nathi.

Utshintsho kulo mgaqo-nkqubo

Lo mgaqo-nkqubo unokuhlaziywa nangaliphi na ixesha. Utshintsho luqala ukusebenza xa lupapashwa kweli phepha, nomhla wokuqala ukusebenza uboniswe phezulu.

Qhagamshelana nathi

Imibuzo malunga nalo mgaqo-nkqubo inokuthunyelwa ngekhonkco loqhagamshelwano elisezantsi kwiphepha ngalinye okanye nge-abidhanan.my.id.
terms.title: Imimiselo & Imiqathango
terms.description: Imimiselo nemiqathango yokusebenzisa i-I Need Convert, isixhobo sasimahla sokuguqula iifayile kwibhrawuza.
terms.body:
Ngokusebenzisa i-I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com), uyavumelana nale mimiselo nemiqathango ilandelayo. Ukuba awuvumelani nayo, nceda ungayisebenzisi le nkonzo.

Malunga nenkonzo

I Need Convert sisixhobo sasimahla sokutshintsha iifayile ukusuka kwifomathi enye ukuya kwenye. Uguqulo lwenzeka kwibhrawuza yakho, ngoko iifayile azifakwa kwiiseva zethu. I Need Convert ayinxulumananga, ayixhaswanga, kwaye ayisebenzisani ne-Apple, iMicrosoft, uGoogle, iAdobe, okanye nawuphi na omnye umnini wefomathi okanye wophawu. Zonke iimpawu zorhwebo zezabanini bazo.

Ukusetyenziswa okuvumelekileyo

  • Guqula kuphela iifayile ezizezakho, onemvume yokuzisebenzisa, okanye ezivumelekileyo ukuba zisetyenziswe ngokomthetho osebenzayo.
  • Ungayisebenzisa le nkonzo ngeenjongo zakho zobuqu okanye zomsebenzi, nje ukuba uhambelana nale mimiselo.

Iifayile zakho noxanduva lwakho

Iifayile oziguqulayo zihlala zizezakho okanye zezomnini wamalungelo azo. Unoxanduva olupheleleyo ngeefayile ozikhethayo nangendlela osebenzisa ngayo iziphumo eziguquliweyo. Soloko ugcina ikopi yefayile yokuqala phambi kokuguqula.

Okungavumelekanga

  • Ukuguqula okanye ukusasaza umxholo owaphula umthetho, ilungelo lokushicilela, okanye ubucala babanye.
  • Ukusebenzisa le nkonzo ukwaphula ukhuseleko lweekopi (DRM) okanye eminye imiqobo yobugcisa.
  • Ukusebenzisa iibhothi, ii-script, okanye ukuzenzekela ukufikelela kwinkonzo ngobuninzi.
  • Ukuphazamisa, ukuthwalisa ngaphezulu, okanye ukuzama ukwaphula ukhuseleko lwewebhusayithi neenkonzo zethu.

Iziphumo zoguqulo

Sizama ukwenza iziphumo zoguqulo zibe zezona zilungileyo kangangoko, kodwa ayizizo zonke iifomathi ezinokuguqulwa ngokugqibeleleyo. Uyilo lwephepha, imifanekiso, iitheyibhile, iifomula, imetadata, okanye umgangatho zinokutshintsha okanye zilahleke, kuxhomekeke kwifomathi yemvelaphi neyokugqibela. Jonga iziphumo phambi kokuzisebenzisela izinto ezibalulekileyo.

Ukufumaneka kwenkonzo

Inkonzo inikezelwa simahla kwaye inokutshintshwa, ithintelwe, okanye iyekiswe nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphandle kwesaziso. Ezinye iifomathi zixhomekeke kubuchule bebhrawuza nesixhobo sakho, ngoko ayilo lonke uguqulo olusoloko lufumaneka.

Ukuzikhupha etyaleni

Inkonzo inikezelwa "njengoko injalo" kwaye "njengoko ifumaneka", ngaphandle kwaso nasiphi na isiqinisekiso, kuquka isiqinisekiso sokuba inkonzo iya kuhlala isebenza, ingenazimpazamo, okanye ifanelekile kwinjongo ethile.

Umda woxanduva

Kangangoko kuvumelekile ngumthetho, asinaxanduva ngayo nayiphi na ilahleko ngqo okanye engathanga ngqo evela ekusebenziseni le nkonzo, kuquka ukulahleka okanye ukonakala kwedatha neefayile.

Amakhonkco aya kumaqela esithathu

Le webhusayithi iqulethe amakhonkco aya kwiisayithi neenkonzo zamaqela esithathu. Asinaxanduva ngemixholo okanye imigaqo-nkqubo yezo sayithi.

Utshintsho kwimimiselo

Le mimiselo nemiqathango inokuhlaziywa nangaliphi na ixesha. Ngokuqhubeka usebenzisa inkonzo emva kokuba utshintsho lupapashiwe, uthathwa njengovumelana noguqulelo lwamva nje.

Umthetho olawulayo

Le mimiselo nemiqathango ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabliki yase-Indonesia.

Qhagamshelana nathi

Imibuzo neengxelo zinokuthunyelwa ngekhonkco loqhagamshelwano elisezantsi kwiphepha ngalinye okanye nge-abidhanan.my.id. Funda kananjalo uMgaqo-nkqubo Wabucala wethu.
